name: Cyprus
headline: WHO ARE YOU TAKING TO THE *TROODOS* MOUNTAINS?
intro: Everyone books the coast. The middle of the island goes to 1,950m, and in February you can ski in the morning and swim in the afternoon.

mustSee.name: Kourion
mustSee.note: Greek and Roman ruins on a cliff above the sea. Go late for the light.

mustSee.name: Paphos
mustSee.note: The mosaics are the reason. The harbour is the reason people stay too long.

mustSee.name: Nicosia
mustSee.note: The last divided capital in Europe. You can cross at Ledra Street with a passport.

mustSee.name: Kykkos Monastery
mustSee.note: The richest monastery on the island, at the top of a very long road.

seasons.spring: March to May is the best of the year. Wildflowers across the Akamas, sea warm enough by May, and the gorges have water in them.
seasons.summer: July and August hit 40°C inland and the coast is booked solid. Troodos is ten degrees cooler and that is where locals go.
seasons.autumn: October and November. Sea still warm, hotels emptying, and the light gets very good.
seasons.winter: Mild on the coast, snow on Olympus. There is a small ski lift, and the joke about skiing and swimming in one day is true for about three weeks.

transport: No railway at all. Buses connect the cities and are cheap, but they stop early and don't serve the mountains usefully. Hire a car — it's the only way to do Troodos or the Akamas, and the motorways are quiet and free. Driving is on the left.
